mapper.select:
SELECT T.sectionSeq, T.id, T.parentId, T.controlType, T.classType, T.text, T.textDesc FROM ( SELECT M.sectionSeq, M.id, M.parentId, M.controlType, M.classType, CASE WHEN M.controlType = '7' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(D.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/') ELSE M.text END AS text, M.textDesc FROM ( SELECT A.MDFM_SCTN_SEQ AS sectionSeq, A.MDFM_CPEM_NO AS id, A.UPR_MDFM_CPEM_NO AS parentId, A.ELMT_CCLS_CD AS controlType, A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD AS classType, CASE WHEN A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD != 'V' THEN ISNULL(A.MDFM_CPEM_CNTE, A.ELMT_BSC_CNTE)
WHEN A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'V' AND A.ELMT_CCLS_CD IN ('4', '5', '6') THEN DECODE(B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE, NULL, NULL, A.MDFM_CPEM_CNTE)
WHEN A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'V' AND A.ELMT_CCLS_CD IN ('4', '5', '6') THEN B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE
WHEN A.MDFM_ELMT_CLS_CD = 'V' AND A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = '7' THEN REGEXP_REPLACE(C.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/') ELSE COALESCE(B.MDFM_ELMT_INPT_CNTE, C.DCST_LDAT, REGEXP_REPLACE(C.INTG_IMG_FILE_PATH_NM, '\\', '/')) END AS text, A.MDFM_CPEM_CNTE AS textDesc, CASE WHEN A.ELMT_CCLS_CD = 7 THEN (ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.ELMT_CCLS_CD ORDER BY A.MDFM_CPEM_ID) - 1) ELSE - 1 END AS imageSeq FROM ODS.S_MRFMFCID A LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRECE B ON B.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND B.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = B.MDFM_CPEM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRLFE C ON C.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND C.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND A.MDFM_CPEM_ID = C.MDFM_CPEM_ID WHERE A.MDFM_ID = #{mdfmId} AND A.MDFM_FOM_SEQ = #{mdfmFomSeq} ) M LEFT OUTER JOIN ODS.S_MRDDRIMD D ON D.MDRC_ID = #{mdrcId} AND D.MDRC_FOM_SEQ = #{mdrcFomSeq} AND M.imageSeq = D.IMG_SEQ ) T
WHERE T.text IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T.sectionSeq, T.id, T.parentId
